turns.q: Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
turns.replyTail:
can cancel after placing a rental request, but the timing really matters:

Before the lender accepts: You can cancel anytime; payment authorisation is released immediately.
After acceptance:
10+ days before start: 100% refund.
10 days–72 hours before: 30% fee (70% refund).
Under 72 hours: Needs lender approval; 50% fee, 50% refunded as platform credit.
Cancellation Policy for Rentals (effective 17th April 2026)
